a: JSONB stores binary JSON with indexing and efficient operators.
GIN indexes support full-text and JSONB containment queries.
B-tree is the default index for equality and range lookups.
ctid is a physical row location; avoid relying on it for application logic.
MVCC keeps concurrent transactions consistent without heavy read locks.
Advisory locks coordinate application-level critical sections.
LISTEN/NOTIFY provides simple pub/sub inside the database.
Extensions like pg_trgm, uuid-ossp, and postgis add capabilities.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs the query and shows actual timings and row counts.
Use PgBouncer or similar to multiplex many clients onto fewer DB connections.
